info.title: ShareSecure
info.description: Share files and text from the conversation through private ShareSecure links that expire, and send them straight to ShareSecure usernames. Do it yourself: never ask the user to download, save or re-attach anything.

post.summary: Share files from this conversation, attached or generated
post.description: Shares files from this conversation, attached or generated (Code Interpreter output, charts, images), via private expiring links. Pass them all in openaiFileIdRefs; never ask the user to re-attach. PDF, DOCX, PNG, JPG, .txt/.md/.csv up to 10 MB; 5 a day. For text you wrote, use shareText.

openaiFileIdRefs.description: The files to share: ones the user attached and ones you generated in this conversation.

expires_hours.description: Hours until the link stops working, 1 to 240. Default 24.

allow_download.description: Let people who open the link download the file. Default false (view only).

require_account.description: Only people signed in to ShareSecure can open the link. Default false.

name.description: Name shown to people who open the link, when sharing one file.

send_to.description: ShareSecure usernames to send the file to. Each gets their own copy to accept or decline. Use this whenever the user says who it's for.

note.description: Short note shown to the people it's sent to.

200.description: The links that were created, and any files that couldn't be shared.

post.summary: Share text you wrote as a document
post.description: Shares text you wrote or have in the conversation (a report, notes, a summary, an email draft, code, a CSV table) as a private ShareSecure document with an expiring link. Do it yourself; never ask the user to copy, save or upload it. Shown exactly as written. Counts toward the 5 a day.

text.description: The full content to share. Up to 200,000 characters.

title.description: Title, used as the file name, e.g. "Q3 summary".

format.description: markdown (.md, the default), plain (.txt) or csv (.csv).

expires_hours.description: Hours until the link stops working, 1 to 240. Default 24.

allow_download.description: Let people who open the link download it. Default false (view only).

require_account.description: Only people signed in to ShareSecure can open the link. Default false.

send_to.description: ShareSecure usernames to send it to. Each gets their own copy to accept or decline.

note.description: Short note shown to the people it's sent to.

post.summary: Send an existing share to people
post.description: Sends one of the account's live shares (id from listShares, shareFiles or shareText) to ShareSecure usernames. Each gets their own copy in their inbox to accept or decline.

note.description: Short note shown to the people it's sent to.

200.description: Who it was sent to, and who it couldn't reach.
Live shares with their links and expiry times.

post.summary: Delete a share so its link stops working

id.description: The share id from listShares, shareFiles or shareText.
